title: About Zero Trust Browser Posture Profiles

blocks.text: On the Zero Trust Browser Posture Profiles page in the Zscaler Admin Console, you can create a Zero Trust Browser Posture Profile to verify whether incoming traffic originates from Zero Trust Browser—either the Enterprise Browser or Browser Extension. You can then select and apply the posture profile when configuring isolation policy rules in Private Access (ZPA) to control application access based on whether the user is connecting via Zero Trust Browser. To learn more, see Configuring a Zero Trust Browser Posture Profile.
The Zero Trust Browser Posture Profiles page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create a Zero Trust Browser Posture Profile to verify incoming traffic from the Enterprise Browser or Browser Extension.
Edit and delete your Zero Trust Browser Posture Profile per your organization's requirements.

blocks.heading: About the Zero Trust Browser Posture Profiles Page

blocks.text: On the Zero Trust Browser Posture Profiles page (Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Private Apps > Browser Posture Profiles), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Customize the columns shown in the table. To learn more, see Using Tables.
View a list of existing posture profiles.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
